problem_statement:
Built-in health-check route

Most of our services define the same `/health` endpoint by hand. Please add a module `fastapi/health.py` with

    add_health_route(app, path="/health", *, status="ok", include_in_schema=False)

- `app` is a `FastAPI` application or an `APIRouter`.
- It registers a GET route at `path` that responds with status 200 and the JSON body `{"status": status}`.
- The route is left out of the OpenAPI schema unless `include_in_schema=True`.
- It returns nothing.

It should be importable as `from fastapi.health import add_health_route`.
